create_doc_read_processor: create a DocReadProcessor instance with random page sampling and custom line break separator
process_ocr_annotation_pages: process OCR annotation pages using the DocReadProcessor with configurable page sampling strategy
decode_document_annotation: decode a document sample annotation and extract page indices and text using DocReadProcessor
expand_annotation_samples: expand a multi-page annotation into individual per-page samples using DocReadProcessor _expand_anno method
configure_page_sampling_strategy: configure DocReadProcessor to use first, all_valid, or all page sampling strategies for document processing
